title: Toolbox: honor brush paint modes + tablet pressure/tilt in engine (1388 deferred)
description: Task 1388 (commit 7c88b41) exposed + persisted brush paint mode (Normal/Fills/Behind/Selection/Inside) and Pressure/Tilt toggles in tool state, but the ENGINE does not yet honor non-Normal paint modes or tablet pressure/tilt when committing brush strokes (planar-merge / pointer path). Implement engine honoring in packages/core (planar/brush path) + wire the pointer pressure. Acceptance: painting with Behind/Fills/Selection/Inside modes composites correctly; pressure varies nib width. See docs/04-toolbox.md follow-ups.
